verdict.rationale: Sumsub's webhooks trigger automatic notifications on verification events, AML screening and anomaly detection run continuously in the background, and the MCP server explicitly lets AI agents autonomously perform Sumsub operations under role permissions — together enabling background automations without manual intervention. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of these automations running reliably at scale, and more detail on autonomous action-taking (not just notification) via webhooks.
